facts.statement: Fossils of Haematosaurus have been found in Boulogne-sur-Mer in northern France.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from Boulogne-sur-Mer in northern France of Jurassic age.

facts.statement: The species was reassigned to the new genus Haematosaurus in 1934.

facts.statement: Haematosaurus is now known to be a marine crocodylomorph.

facts.statement: Due to fragmentary fossil material, Haematosaurus is currently regarded as a nomen dubium.
facts.quote: Due to the fragmentary nature of the material associated with the genus, it is currently regarded as a nomen dubium.

facts.statement: Haematosaurus lived during the Kimmeridgian stage, between 152.21 and 149.2 million years ago.
